We’re also cooking up some fun little features to make your playthrough even more entertaining… maybe even a way to mess with the NPCs? 👀 We’ll share more once things are solid—no empty promises![/p][p][/p][p align="start"]As for the big question—the release date—we’ll have a clear answer very soon. Stay tuned![/p][p align="start"]Thanks so much for your ongoing support, everyone. Can’t wait to share the game with you all very soon![/p]

notes.title: 《Cthulhu Detective》v0.4.1 Updates Announcement
notes.content:
We’ve also received a lot of feedback from players over the past few days, leading to this update. The main focus? Addressing one of the most-discussed topics among fans: What happens after reaching a certain level of character affinity? As one of the most player-responsive dev teams (or so we’d like to think), how could we ignore your expectations?

With this update, all major characters in the Demo now have their own affinity-based side endings (yes, covering all genders and ages). Whether you’ve already played or are new to the game, feel free to take on the challenge!

Additionally, we’ve collected numerous bug reports—special thanks to those in our community who provided detailed descriptions. Issues like ​​freezing​​ and ​​"insufficient tokens"​​ have been fixed. Just restart Steam to download the Demo update, and we’d love for you to test it out again.

​​Specific fixes and improvements include:​​

Fixed Ford’s tab freeze issue
Fixed unresponsive evidence pickup leading to crashes
Increased token count by 50% (applies to existing saves)
Optimized sound effect volume
Added a dedicated bug-reporting feature
Polished story content (yes, even typos are fixed)
Added dialogue skip functionality
The Demo will also be featured in the ​​Steam Next Fest​​, and we’ll keep gathering feedback to deliver a better experience. Thank you all for your support and enthusiasm!
